title: Urinary Tract Agents: Nitrofurantoin, Fosfomycin, Methenamine

questions.question: Regarding intravenous fosfomycin:

parts.text: List THREE approved indications by Health Canada.
What is the mechanism of action of fosfomycin?
Name ONE Enterobacterales that is intrinsically resistant to fosfomycin.

questions.model_answer:
a) 3 Health Canada-approved indications for IV fosfomycin: (1) complicated urinary tract infection (including pyelonephritis); (2) hospital-acquired bacterial pneumonia/ventilator-associated bacterial pneumonia (as combination therapy); (3) bacteremia associated with complicated UTI.
b) Mechanism of action: fosfomycin irreversibly inhibits the enzyme MurA (UDP-N-acetylglucosamine enolpyruvyl transferase), which catalyzes the first committed step of peptidoglycan synthesis (formation of UDP-N-acetylmuramic acid), thereby blocking bacterial cell wall synthesis.
c) Enterobacterales with intrinsic resistance to fosfomycin: Providencia spp. (Morganella morganii is also an accepted answer).
questions.beyond_mandell: Health Canada product monograph for IV fosfomycin (approved indications) - not detailed in this Mandell chapter.

parts.text: Name 3 Health Canada-approved indications for IV fosfomycin (1.5)
What is the major mechanism for fosfomycin (0.5)
Name one Enterobacterales species that is intrinsically resistant to fosfomycin (0.5)

cohort_answer.text: Indications: Complicated UTI/pyelonephritis; Nosocomial pneumonia; Osteomyelitis; Bacterial meningitis; Skin and soft tissue infection; Bacteremia related to above indications. Mechanism: Interferes with cell wall synthesis - inhibits phosphoenolpyruvate synthetase, blocking formation of N-acetylmuramic acid, ultimately interfering with early cell wall synthesis (Mandell's). Intrinsically resistant species: Morganella morganii

questions.question: Given list of antibiotics and side effects (Amikacin, Azithromycin, Clindamycin, Pip/Tazo, Ertapenem, Linezolid, Levofloxacin, Nitrofurantoin), and antibiotics can only be used once, match each side effect to an antibiotic:

parts.text: Isolated thrombocytopenia | Isolated neutropenia | Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis | Peripheral neuropathy | Tendonopathy

cohort_answer.text: Isolated thrombocytopenia - piptazo. Isolated neutropenia - azithromycin. Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis - nitrofurantoin. Peripheral neuropathy - linezolid. Tendonopathy - levofloxacin

questions.question: 8. Antimicrobial intrinsic resistance. Table: | Nitrofurantoin | Cephalexin | Fosfomycin | Amox-Clav for Morganella, Proteus mirabilis, E. cloacae

parts.text: Fill out the intrinsic resistance table

cohort_answer.text: Morganella: Nitrofurantoin R, Cephalexin R, Fosfomycin unreliable/no breakpoints, Amox-Clav R. Proteus mirabilis: Nitrofurantoin R, Cephalexin None (susceptible), Fosfomycin unreliable/no breakpoints, Amox-Clav None (susceptible). E. cloacae: Nitrofurantoin +/-, Cephalexin R, Fosfomycin unreliable/no breakpoints, Amox-Clav R

parts.text: Name three antibiotics with gram negative coverage that are intrinsically resistant to proteus and providencia

questions.model_answer: 3 gram-negative-active urinary agents intrinsically inactive against Proteus and Providencia: (1) nitrofurantoin, (2) fosfomycin, (3) polymyxin B/colistin.
